definitions.explanation: The time when the sun goes below the horizon in the evening. Also refers to the phenomenon itself.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}の{入|い}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日|ひ}の{入|い}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{六時半|ろくじはん}ごろだ。

⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沈|しず}む→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{日|ひ}の{入|い}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took photos while watching the beautiful sunset sinking into the sea.

notes:
Literally 'the sun's entering' (⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ sun + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ possessive + {入|い}り entering). Describes the sun setting below the horizon.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日|ひ}の{入|い}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧: sunset time
- {日|ひ}の{入|い}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧: sunset is early
- {日|ひ}の{入|い}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧: sunset is late
- {日|ひ}の{入|い}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to watch the sunset

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧: the evening sun, setting sun — refers more to the visual appearance of the sun as it sets, often with poetic or aesthetic overtones
- ⟦{日没|にちぼつ}→日没：04657_nichibotsu⟧: sunset — a more formal, technical term used in weather reports and astronomy
- ⟦{日|ひ}の{出|で}→日の出：17596_hinode⟧: sunrise — the counterpart, referring to the sun rising in the morning

SEASONAL NOTE:
Sunset times vary significantly by season in Japan. In winter, sunset can be as early as 4:30 PM, while in summer it can be past 7:00 PM. Weather forecasts and news commonly report ⟦{日|ひ}の{出|で}→日の出：17596_hinode⟧ and {日|ひ}の{入|い}り times.
